tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec108/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 -B plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py --graph .dev-graph/state/graph.json --repo-root . --require-canonical-envelope --strict-artifact-readiness | head -30; python3 -B - <<'E'
import json,hashlib,os
g=json.load(open('.dev-graph/state/graph.json'))
print("sha256:"+hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(g,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest())
for n in g['nodes']:
    p=n['file_path'];print(p,os.path.realpath(p).startswith(os.getcwd()+'/'),hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest())
    s=n['source_lineage'];print(s['source_path'],hashlib.sha256(open(s['source_path'],'rb').read()).hexdigest()==s['source_digest'])
E
shasum -a 256 specs/*.md architecture/*.md; ls specs architecture; git status --short
